user.title: DomRes
user.description: Sign in with your DomRes account. The login type is detected automatically. Leave the optional Customer header blank unless its value is known for your account.

data_description.username: Enter the phone number or email used at registration as your login.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to DomRes or retrieve the account list.
error.verification_required: The service requested an additional sign-in verification step that is not supported yet.
error.no_accounts: No accounts were found for this user.

init.title: Reading deadline notification
init.description: Choose how many days before the end of the reading period to raise domres_reading_deadline. The event is raised once per account while the period is active.

data.deadline_days: Days before the end of the period

data_description.deadline_days: Use 0 to raise the event on the last day. Allowed range: 0–31 days.
